subject.title: acpx plugin dependencies missing from Nix derivation — causes EACCES

question: Should acpx now be included in the supported declaratively packaged runtime-plugin set despite the earlier not-planned closure at https://github.com/openclaw/nix-openclaw/issues/73?
rationale: The technical expectation matches repository packaging policy, but the earlier closure indicates a potentially intentional support-boundary decision that automation should not reverse.

options.title: Package acpx declaratively
options.body: Treat acpx as supported and add its full dependency closure plus an immutable-store gateway startup check.

options.title: Keep acpx unsupported
options.body: Confirm the earlier scope decision and document that acpx is not part of the supported batteries-included runtime-plugin set.

recommendation.title: Package acpx declaratively
recommendation.body: Treat acpx as supported and add its full dependency closure plus an immutable-store gateway startup check.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history in runtime-plugin packaging and gateway startup validation.
